title: dispatch-gates: a diff touching `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` derives no `check:durability-log-level`, though that guard scans the file and reds the required `Lint & Repo Gates` (PR #23567)
body:
Filing gate **①**, class **(a)**, a `tooling` defect with a named instance. The derived gate list missed a guard that reads the changed file, which cost a review round: PR #23567 (#23501) went red in CI on that guard, and it took a patch round to fix.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 1 (#6024) · `os-bill` · session `session_01FLwgbTSmGMrqsXkBDsiwfG`, from #23501's round-2 `os-dev-report` (`6182631933`, out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** triage grades and routes it. The landing is the derivation in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` (or the guard's own population declaration), whichever owns "which paths does `check:durability-log-level` read".

## Measured

- **The miss, re-measured by this seat** at `origin/main` `f3fd209b34`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` prints 47 commands. `durability` appears in 0 of them. Control: `route-envelope` appears in 1 of the same 47.
- **The guard reads that file:** in PR #23567's CI (run 38662218032, job 116185915419), the `Lint · docs & code guards` lane's step "Durability-degradation log-level guard" was the one red gate of 55. Its finding named `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:1793`. The required aggregator `Lint & Repo Gates` went red with it.
- **What the dev saw:** it ran the whole derived list (64 families on its diff), and `--ran` reconciled 64 of 64 with 0 NOT-MEASURED. It never ran `pnpm check:durability-log-level` (`node scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs`, `package.json:144`). The dev measured the guard's red locally at `84124fefd` (exit 1) and green at the fix `7044dd98d` (exit 0).

## Why it matters (北极星「仪器为车队服务」)

A dev who follows the dispatch order exactly, running every derived family with `--ran` at 0 unrun, still ships a red PR. The cost is one review round per such diff (here, a patch round plus a CI cycle). With the guard derived for the paths it scans, that dev would have caught it before pushing.

## Acceptance (a proposal; triage's call)

- `dispatch-gates --commands` names `check:durability-log-level` for a diff touching any path the guard scans. The derivation reads the guard's own scan roots, ⛔ not a hand-copied list.
- A `dispatch-gates` self-test case on `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` that fails without the change.
- ⛔ The guard itself is not weakened or narrowed.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included:
- `dispatch-gates derived list misses check:durability-log-level guard packages/runtime catch seam not derived`: 0 hits.
- `dispatch-gates blind spot gate not named durability log level`: 55 hits, top 10 read. The nearest are #23240 (closed; objectui-lane derivation), #19172 (closed; the type-check lane) and #13000 (closed; staging dependencies). None is this guard.

Dedupe words: dispatch-gates durability-log-level not derived; check:durability-log-level population packages/runtime; derived list misses durability guard.
